name: Django DEBUG left on in settings
attack_scenario: An attacker forces any unhandled exception (malformed input, a missing object) and reads the yellow Django debug page, harvesting SECRET_KEY, database DSN, and internal paths, enough to forge session cookies and pivot deeper.
negative_test_hint: request "/nonexistent-view-that-raises" to force an exception and assert the response is a generic error page with no traceback, settings, or SECRET_KEY leaked

exemplar.explanation: A hardcoded DEBUG = True makes Django render its technical-500 page — full tracebacks, local variables, the whole settings module including SECRET_KEY and DB credentials, and every executed SQL query — to any visitor who triggers an exception. DEBUG must be environment-driven and default to False in production.
